Ivy: Hypothetical: our prod model asked for a LinkedIn recommendation. What does Rina write? :thinking_face:
Marcus: 'Worked with this model for 2 years. Drives conversations forward and occasionally invents charming backstories.' :sweat_smile:
Dee: 'Highly collaborative; great at cross-functional hallucinations. Brought fresh perspectives to every prompt.' :nerd_face:
Rina: @Dee stop, I'm trying to be professional. Maybe: 'Reliable under pressure, scales quietly, recommends quantization as needed.'
WelcomeBot: Tip: LinkedIn recommendations should be 2-3 short paragraphs. :scroll:
Ivy: Bonus section: "Would rehire?" Options: Yes / Yes if retrained / Only after logs reviewed / Ask me in Q4
Marcus: Voting: Yes if retrained. :raised_hands:
Dee: 'Would manage a team of smaller models.' Little brag. :smile:
Rina: Manager blurb draft: 'Ivy coached the model through canonical prompts & boundary cases. Result: 17% fewer tangents.'
Marcus: Can't tell if that's an OK stat to invent in a recommendation. :eyes:
Ivy: Make it vague: 'measurable improvement in focus and throughput.' :ok_hand:
Dee: Also add a soft skill: 'Excellent at small talk during system maintenance windows.' :coffee:
Rina: Final draft I will post: "Consistent, adaptable, and surprisingly polite. Would work with again." Want an emoji?
Marcus: Add the tiny GPU emoji if we had one. :chip: :laughing:
WelcomeBot: Recommendation posted. Reaction: :tada: (not real).
